Per function: DISABLE its rule locally (remove the entry in your worktree's webfrank.json + configure), baseline the RAW residual, then drive it at source with the full modern kit (context <fn>; the rule itself is your best brief — its window/recolor map says EXACTLY what the gap is). Either outcome is a win; do not force source closes and do not soft-cap to save time. Mandatory result policy + strict/equivalent split rules apply; full ninja 'main.dol: OK' per function (rule disabled = expect the fn NonMatching in that build — the DOL still verifies); defake_gate per TU; pins elsewhere untouched; parallel fleets please pick other TUs
